values.description: Triggers the CS autograder CodeBuild project on assignment deadlines (daily at 23:00 UTC)
values.name: autograder-deadline-schedule

values.description: CS class autograder: executes student code in a pinned environment inside an isolated VPC and stores grading results in S3
values.name: autograder

source.buildspec:
version: 0.2

env:
  shell: bash
  variables:
    GRADE_RESULTS_DIR: "results"
    STUDENT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: "900"
    EXPECTED_PYTHON_MAJOR: "3"

phases:
  install:
    commands:
      - echo "==> Pinned grading environment = aws/codebuild/amazonlinux-x86_64-standard:5.0"
      - set -euo pipefail
      - test "$(python3 -c 'import sys; print(sys.version_info.major)')" = "$EXPECTED_PYTHON_MAJOR" && echo "Pinned Python major version verified"
      - git --version
  pre_build:
    commands:
      - set -euo pipefail
      - echo "==> Fetching the GitHub token from Secrets Manager through the VPC interface endpoint"
      - GITHUB_TOKEN="$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id "$GITHUB_TOKEN_SECRET_ARN" --query SecretString --output text)"
      - umask 077
      - printf 'machine github.com\nlogin x-access-token\npassword %s\n' "$GITHUB_TOKEN" > "$HOME/.netrc"
      - unset GITHUB_TOKEN
      - git ls-remote --heads "$STUDENT_REPO_URL" > /dev/null && echo "GitHub access verified without exposing any secret in build logs"
  build:
    commands:
      - set -euo pipefail
      - echo "==> Executing student code. Outbound internet is blocked at the VPC layer."
      - STUDENT_WORKDIR=$(mktemp -d /tmp/student-code.XXXXXX)
      - cp -a "$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/." "$STUDENT_WORKDIR/"
      - cd "$STUDENT_WORKDIR"
      - GRADE_EXIT_CODE=0
      - timeout "$STUDENT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS" python3 -m pytest "$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/tests" -v --junitxml="$STUDENT_WORKDIR/junit.xml" 2>&1 | tee grading-output.log || GRADE_EXIT_CODE=$?
      - echo "Student code finished with exit code $GRADE_EXIT_CODE (124 means the timeout guard fired)"
  post_build:
    commands:
      - set -euo pipefail
      - rm -f "$HOME/.netrc"
      - if [ "$GRADE_EXIT_CODE" = "0" ]; then GRADE_STATUS=PASS; else GRADE_STATUS=FAIL; fi
      - mkdir -p "$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/$GRADE_RESULTS_DIR"
      - cp "$STUDENT_WORKDIR/junit.xml" "$STUDENT_WORKDIR/grading-output.log" "$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/$GRADE_RESULTS_DIR/" 2>/dev/null || true
      - printf '{"build_id":"%s","grade_status":"%s","student_exit_code":"%s","repository":"%s","completed_at":"%s"}\n' "$CODEBUILD_BUILD_ID" "$GRADE_STATUS" "$GRADE_EXIT_CODE" "$STUDENT_REPO_URL" "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" > "$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/$GRADE_RESULTS_DIR/result.json"
      - echo "==> Grading result staged for upload to the results bucket"

artifacts:
  files:
    - 'results/**/*'

values.name: autograder-codebuild-service-role
